title: 9,500 Liters of Clean Water Delivered to Drought-Affected Residents in Gorontalo
excerpt: Relawan Nusantara delivered 9,500 liters of clean water to help 350 households affected by drought in the villages of Biluhu Tengah and Biluhu Barat, Gorontalo.
seoTitle: 9,500 Liters of Water for Drought-Hit Gorontalo - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Relawan Nusantara delivered 9,500 liters of clean water to help 350 drought-affected households in Biluhu Tengah and Biluhu Barat villages, Gorontalo.
html:
A prolonged dry season has left communities in several parts of Gorontalo Regency, Gorontalo Province, struggling to obtain clean water. To help meet residents’ basic needs, Relawan Nusantara delivered 500 refillable gallon jugs of clean water, with a total volume of 9,500 liters, to communities in Lalape Hamlet, Biluhu Tengah Village, and Biluhu Barat Village on Saturday, 8 November 2026.

Residents Must Travel 2–3 Kilometers to Get Water

Drought has gripped the area since August 2026. The situation has a direct impact on people’s daily lives, especially in meeting their water needs for household use.

In Lalape Hamlet, Biluhu Tengah Village, for example, residents have to travel around 2–3 kilometers to get water from another village. Using small carts, they do their best to haul water home to meet their daily needs.

Similar hardship is being felt by the people of Biluhu Barat Village, who also face limited access to clean water because of the drought. This situation makes the arrival of clean water assistance deeply meaningful for residents.

9,500 Liters of Clean Water for 350 Households

In response to these conditions, Relawan Nusantara, together with 10 personnel involved in the activity, including the local village head, moved to deliver clean water assistance directly to the community.

A total of 500 gallon jugs, each with a capacity of 19 liters, were distributed over two days. This brought the total assistance delivered to 9,500 liters of clean water, benefiting around 350 households in the two villages.

Even so, the community’s needs remain considerable. Based on the data gathered, the number of families in Biluhu Tengah Village and Biluhu Barat Village is around 860 households. This means the assistance delivered so far has reached only some of the families affected by the drought.

A Shared Effort to Meet Residents’ Basic Needs

The distribution of clean water will continue as part of Relawan Nusantara’s commitment to standing with communities as they face the impact of drought. After all, access to clean water is not merely an everyday need, but an essential part of sustaining community life.

Through this humanitarian action, Relawan Nusantara hopes the assistance provided can ease the burden on residents amid the difficulty of obtaining clean water. More than that, this action is an invitation for all parties to join hands in helping communities still facing a clean water crisis caused by the prolonged dry season.
